title: The Diggers
summary: The Redhand who left the mill went to Wickham Keep, and Osric Hale has heard they are digging in its cellars. Bandits don't dig. Somebody must be paying them to.

steps.journal: Go into Wickham Keep, on the Wickham road north of the crossroads, and down to its second floor.

objectives.label: Down to the Keep's second floor

steps.journal: Find Captain Garrow in the hall of the Keep's second floor and put him down.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale in Thornwick.
done: Garrow is done collecting. The robed strangers who paid him to dig are not done digging.
